tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and source note indicate a two-layer fin bridge, while the five available measurements are one-dimensional steady-input variation. A targeted open-branch observation can expose the missing branch/temporal response at lower cost than a fine trajectory batch.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a stationary smooth model from the five initial rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observations vary only u_now at fixed H, x_now, u_past, mem_conv, and s_grad; they do not identify the two-layer temporal bridge dynamics.
An open-branch contrast is the more targeted and lower-cost way to distinguish the bridge mechanism; a larger trajectory batch is not yet justified.
Auxiliary nuisance measurements do not resolve the temporal-mechanism ambiguity.
